dogecoin.text: Last year, along with lots of other cryptocurrencies, the price of dogecoin skyrocketed again. The total value of all the dogecoins out there reached more than a billion dollars at it's peak.

In 2014, someone convinced a lot of people to invest a lot of dogecoin in a new shady cryptocurrency business. It collapsed, and people lost their money. Palmer gave away all the dogecoin he had to charity.
They also donated dogecoin to train guide dogs, to drill wells in Kenya.
